tooltips.title: Desktop public demo
tooltips.description: This build is a desktop-only public demo using synthetic data and local QA-only telemetry.

tooltips.title: Session mode
tooltips.description: Shows whether this mandate is running in guest browser mode or with authenticated cloud persistence.

tooltips.title: Onboarding
tooltips.description: Reopens the guided tour so you can revisit the core command surfaces and interface flow.

tooltips.title: Mission brief
tooltips.description: Opens the mandate framing, objectives, and strategic context for the current campaign.

tooltips.title: Status report
tooltips.description: Summarizes current resources, metrics, and recent operations in a single executive report.

tooltips.title: Session menu
tooltips.description: Access save controls, settings, tutorial replay, credits, and exit options.

tooltips.title: Turn progression
tooltips.description: Tracks the current act, current turn, recent action history, and the latest resolution signals.

tooltips.title: Act
tooltips.description: Narrative phase of the campaign. Each act changes the framing and pressure of the mandate.

tooltips.title: Turn counter
tooltips.description: Shows how far the mandate has progressed through the fixed campaign timeline.

tooltips.title: Actions remaining
tooltips.description: How many command decisions you can still take before ending the current turn.

tooltips.title: Operational pressure
tooltips.description: Composite signal combining urgent intel, critical zones, opposition pressure, and deadline risk.

tooltips.title: Resources
tooltips.description: Mission resources available for decisions, deployments, and oversight commitments.

tooltips.title: Budget
tooltips.description: Mission funding available for operations and programs. This panel reports it in millions of dollars.

tooltips.title: Political capital
tooltips.description: Diplomatic leverage you can spend on negotiations, oversight, and politically costly moves.

tooltips.title: Personnel
tooltips.description: Deployable AU staff and mission capacity available for field commitments.

tooltips.title: Intel points
tooltips.description: Analytical capacity used to investigate threats and uncover hidden operational risk.

tooltips.title: Time
tooltips.description: Shared mandate clock. Actions and turn advancement both consume this limited pool.

tooltips.title: Regional metrics
tooltips.description: Top-line indicators used to judge mandate performance across security, legitimacy, and coalition health.

tooltips.title: Stability
tooltips.description: Overall level of order and control across the operating environment. Higher is better.

tooltips.title: Insurgency
tooltips.description: Active militant pressure and organized armed threat across the theater. Lower is better.

tooltips.title: Civilian support
tooltips.description: Public confidence that the mandate is protecting communities and acting credibly.

tooltips.title: Global legitimacy
tooltips.description: External trust in the mandate from international partners, observers, and funding actors.

tooltips.title: Regional synergy
tooltips.description: Level of cooperation among regional institutions, neighboring states, and mission partners.

tooltips.title: Scenario panel
tooltips.description: Context strip for the currently selected territory or zone, with fast links into relevant detail surfaces.

tooltips.title: Intelligence feed
tooltips.description: Filed briefings from the current session. Use this to monitor urgency, confidence, and geographic scope before acting.

tooltips.title: All briefings
tooltips.description: Shows every filed intel item, regardless of urgency.

tooltips.title: Urgent briefings
tooltips.description: Shows only high-priority reports that should influence near-term decisions.

tooltips.title: Normal briefings
tooltips.description: Shows routine or lower-urgency reporting that still adds context to the mandate.

tooltips.title: Intel briefing
tooltips.description: Open the full briefing to inspect the headline, confidence, urgency, source channel, and affected scope.

tooltips.title: Actor roster
tooltips.description: Canonical stakeholders you can monitor or engage during the current mandate.

tooltips.title: All actors
tooltips.description: Shows every active actor currently visible in the roster, regardless of dialogue state.

tooltips.title: Dialogue open
tooltips.description: Shows actors whose dialogue channel is currently available this turn.

tooltips.title: Dialogue pending
tooltips.description: Shows actors with authored dialogue that is still locked behind turn timing or trigger conditions.

tooltips.title: Actor card
tooltips.description: Quick profile surface for a stakeholder. Open it to inspect role, relationship status, and engagement route.

tooltips.title: Engage
tooltips.description: Jumps directly into the currently available engagement route for that actor when one is open.

tooltips.title: Command pressure
tooltips.description: Live signal of how much operational strain the mandate is under before you commit another action or end turn.

tooltips.title: Take action
tooltips.description: Open the action planner to allocate resources and target the next intervention.

tooltips.title: End turn
tooltips.description: Resolve the turn, process events, and advance the mandate clock once you are done issuing actions.
